headline: Six Fronts See Heavy Fighting Bases Shift
war_summary: By day 451‑452 the war remains a grinding stalemate punctuated by a handful of fiercely contested corridors. Weathered Expanse leads the butcher’s bill with 11,899 Colonial and 16,776 Warden dead in the last 24 hours and 37 ownership changes, the most recent just minutes ago. Callahans Passage follows with 9,333 Colonial and 10,681 Warden losses and 22 base swaps, while Nevish Line adds 5,222 Colonial and 4,578 Warden casualties amid 14 flips. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf each record roughly 5,000‑8,000 dead per side and 17‑19 exchanges, and Linn Mercy logs 1,863 Colonial and 4,966 Warden dead with seven changes. Across these sectors casualty rates have spiked in the last hour (accelerating trends) before easing on the two‑hour window, and fresh enlistments are rising sharply, signalling sustained manpower commitment. The remaining regions stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership movement.
